info.title: Habit Tracker
info.description: Configurable authentication: disabled rejects private requests; local accepts the default user PAT/service-account tokens; oidc verifies RFC 9068 access tokens and tenant-scoped PATs. Global errors: 429 rate limit, 504 deadline. Max JSON body: 16384 bytes.

200.description: SSE invalidation; authenticated header, reconnect and GET dashboard

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Required, 1..128 visible ASCII bytes, scoped to user

200.description: Job metadata without payload or credentials

Connect.description: No Debug: the credential is accepted once and persisted only as AEAD ciphertext.

IssuedToken.description: Serialized once at issuance. Deliberately no Debug or Clone for the secret.

category.description: Card category. Omission defaults to daily for backwards compatibility.

RestException.description: An excluded local date, never a successful completion.

weekdays.description: ISO weekdays, Monday=1, Sunday=7; unique and non-empty.

Session.description: Public view of the authenticated principal; never serializes credentials.

XpLedgerEntry.description: Append-only credits and compensations derived from completed periods.

bearer.description: Opaque PAT or service-account token; enable AUTH_MODE=tokens. Disabled mode refuses all private requests.
